decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the feed to focus on actual backpacks, as several items (chairs, coffee pots, hammocks) were miscategorized. My consideration set includes a high-capacity hiking pack (Mardingtop), a mid-sized tactical bag (G4Free), a branded mesh pack (adidas), a hydration pack (Lunidry), and a sling bag (NICGID). I decided on the adidas Hermosa Mesh Backpack because it has the highest overall rating (4.7) and specific positive feedback regarding its long-term durability (lasting 2-3 years for a high school student), whereas several other options had reviews complaining about broken zippers or straps after only a few months of use.
